The European partnership FOREST (FOrests, forestry, and the forest-based sector: REsearch and innovation for a Sustainable Transition)) aims to promote research and innovation to accelerate the transition to a resilient and knowledge-intensive forest-based sector that contributes to a sustainable circular bioeconomy and to society as a whole.

title: European collaborations for sustainable food systems - FutureFoodS call 3
audience: Actors in civil society, companies, public sector and academia with a branch or operating location in Sweden. At least one Swedish actor who is not part of academia is required. Multiple Swedish partners require one coordinator for Swedish funding.
eligibility_text: Actors in civil society, companies, public sector and academia with a branch or operating location in Sweden. At least one Swedish actor who is not part of academia is required. Multiple Swedish partners require one coordinator for Swedish funding.
topics: European collaborations for sustainable food systems - FutureFoodS call 3

FutureFoodS is a co-funded partnership in Horizon Europe. Sweden participates through Vinnova and Formas. It is planned for 6 calls for proposals over a 10-year period, starting in autumn 2024. The goal is to change to more sustainable food systems. The system perspective is the key and a prerequisite. Trans- and interdisciplinarity, transformation, sustainability (three dimensions) and engaging a diversity of actors are guiding elements.
